# pd39route settings reference

<!-- Generated by gr/settings_doc.py from gr/pd39_settings.h. Do not edit by hand: change the table and rerun it (CI checks that this file is current). -->

Every setting `pd39route` reads: 188 in all. All are environment variables. A settings file (`gr/*.env`) is a list of them, one `NAME=value` per line. `USAGE.md` explains how the flows load them; load a file line by line, never by sourcing it in a shell (`fast08.env`'s `PD39ROUTE_PORTFOLIO` holds `;`).

- **Checked before any work.** A name with a known prefix that is not in this table, an `int` or `real` value that is not a number, a `flag` that is not 0 or 1, or a `text` word outside its set: each stops the run before it starts, with every problem listed (`gr/pd39_run.h`).
- **Default** is the value used when the setting is unset. "unset (off)" means the mechanism runs only when the setting is given.
- **Standard files** gives the value each standard flow's settings files set. The ISPD 2008 standard is `@standard.env @fast08.env`, and `@speed08.env` is layered after it. ISPD 2024 adds `@standard24.env @fast24.env` to `standard.env`; ISPD 2025 adds `@standard25.env` to those.
- **Implications** of a value are in the Part named in each meaning: `HISTORY_COST_SWEEP.md` records what it was measured to do.
- `./pd39route --settings` prints this table, with what the current environment sets.

## Kinds

| kind | value |
|---|---|
| flag | 0 or 1 |
| onifset | on when set; the value must be 1 |
| int | a whole number |
| real | a number |
| number | a number (its own parser checks its range) |
| list | several values, comma-separated (format in the meaning) |
| text | a word from a set |
| file | a file or folder path |

## Build and backend

| setting | kind | default | meaning | standard files |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GR_GPU` | text | auto | pattern-stage backend auto, cpu, metal or cuda (GPU builds only; the g++ build is CPU) |  |
| `GR_METALLIB` | file | unset (compile the kernel at run time) | a precompiled Metal library (Metal builds only) |  |
| `GR_SIGNPOSTS` | flag | 0 | Instruments stage markers (signpost.h, Part 126) | `standard.env`: `1` |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VROUTE_CLEANUP_PASSES` | int | 30 | post-convergence cleanup: passes |  |

| `VROUTE_EPS` | real | 0.02 | price step epsilon |  |
| `VROUTE_FAST_ROUNDS` | int | 60 | cheap tier: most rounds | `standard.env`: `60` |
| `VROUTE_HIST_EXPONENT_ESCALATION` | real | 0 | history: exponent added per round in ratio mode |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_FACTOR` | real | 1.1 | history: factor in mult mode |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_MODE` | text | add | history: mult or ratio (add: additive, the default) Words: `add, mult, ratio`. |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_RATIO_EXPONENT` | real | 1 | history: exponent in ratio mode |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_RELAX` | flag | 1 | history: 0 = permanent, no LIFO relaxation (0 or 1) |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_SCALE` | text | off | history: overflow: scale each step by the overflow (off: the default) Words: `off, overflow`. |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_STEP` | real | 0.05 | history: additive step |  |
| `VROUTE_HIST_STREAK` | int | 1 | history: over-capacity rounds in a row before it grows |  |
| `VROUTE_MAX_MARGIN` | int | 6 | largest search margin (-1: nv4route's rule) |  |
| `VROUTE_MSMV` | flag | 1 | 0: fixed-topology slow tier instead of MSMV maze growth (0 or 1) |  |
| `VROUTE_POWER` | real | 1.5 | price curve exponent |  |
| `VROUTE_SLOW_ROUNDS` | int | 150 | slow tier: most rounds | `standard.env`: `150` |
| `VROUTE_THRESHOLD` | real | 0.05 | per-round pricing threshold |  |
| `VROUTE_TRACE` | onifset | unset (off) | per-round trace | `standard.env`: `1` |
